title: TikTok Videos Are Coming to Disney+
paragraphs: Disney and TikTok have announced a new partnership that will bring videos made by TikTok creators to the streaming service Disney+.

The deal was announced on August 5, 2026. Under the agreement, selected short videos made by fans on TikTok will appear in Verts, a feed of vertical videos inside the Disney+ app. The videos will also stay on TikTok.

Disney+ launched Verts in the United States in March 2026. Like TikTok, it lets users swipe through short videos on their phones. Until now, however, Verts only showed scenes and moments from movies and shows that are already on Disney+.

As part of the deal, TikTok creators will get access to material from hundreds of Disney movies and series. This includes characters and scenes from brands such as Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars and FX. Creators can use this material in their own videos.

Creators must choose to take part in the program, and Disney will decide which videos appear in Verts. Disney says it will change the selection of videos regularly. The service will start as a test in the US in the coming months, and it will later expand to other countries. The companies did not say how much money is involved or how many creators will take part.

Asad Ayaz, a senior executive at Disney, said that "The best storytellers are fans first." Dawn Yang of TikTok said that creators' videos help keep movies and shows popular by turning them into conversations.

According to TikTok, fans posted an average of 6.5 million posts about movies and TV every day last year. The company also says that nearly half of the viewers it surveyed later watched a movie or show after seeing related content on the app.
The deal comes after Disney decided not to continue with a planned partnership with OpenAI, which would have let users make AI videos with Disney characters.
